meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对本机 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装是否健康且与最新版一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 Codex 开发,最近一次安装、升级或改配置后遇到了奇怪问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and hit odd behavior after an install, update, or config change

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成「LazyCodex 安装医生」:检查本机 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的版本、配置、插件等是否和官方最新版一致,最后给出一份带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等词,或安装/更新/改配置后 Codex 行为异常,或怀疑本地安装过期、损坏、想核对最新源码时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 做个健康检查。
say.note: 会检查版本、插件配置并与最新版对比,输出检查报告。

say.text: 我更新 Codex 后它变得很奇怪,帮我诊断。
say.note: 会检查本地安装与配置,找出可能的问题点。

say.text: 检查一下我的 LazyCodex 安装有没有过期或跑偏。
say.note: 会和最新源码对比,看版本是否滞后、配置是否有漂移。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude becomes a LazyCodex install doctor: it inspects local LazyCodex and Codex CLI versions, config, and plugins against the latest official sources, then prints a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or ask for a doctor/health check; also when Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change, or you suspect a stale, drifted, or broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex install.
say_en.note: Checks versions, plugins, and config against latest, then reports.

say_en.text: Codex started acting weird after an update — diagnose it.
say_en.note: Inspects local install and config to find likely issues.

say_en.text: Is my LazyCodex install outdated or drifted?
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources for version lag or config drift.
